title: Peruvian Aubergine Gratin
description: A flavorful Peruvian dish featuring roasted aubergine, topped with a crunchy gratin. This recipe is perfect for a dinner or snack.
instructions: Cut aubergine into 1-inch slices and place on a baking sheet. Drizzle with olive oil and sprinkle with salt, black pepper, and minced garlic.
Roast aubergine slices in the oven for 20-25 minutes, flipping halfway through.
In a separate pan, toast the crunchy plantain chips over medium heat for 2-3 minutes, until crispy.
In a greased 8x8-inch baking dish, arrange roasted aubergine slices in a single layer.
Sprinkle shredded cheese over the aubergine, followed by toasted plantain chips.
Bake the gratin in the preheated oven for 15-20 minutes, until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove the gratin from the oven and sprinkle with chopped cilantro and a squeeze of lemon juice.
Serve warm, garnished with additional cilantro if desired.
